d: Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) falls in love while helping a woman (Audie England) and her band of rebels defeat a tyrannical king (Michael Keir-Morrissey). With Michael Hurst.
Hercules promotes peace by organizing an athletic competition between the warring Spartans and Eleans, thus creating the Olympic Games.
Iolaus is used as a pawn by the scheming love goddess Aphrodite to prevent a marriage between the children of two feuding kings.
Hercules and Iolaus get caught in the middle of a love triangle when they volunteer to help a king.
Royal look-alike Iolaus stands in for Orestes at his coronation and wedding to prevent usurper Minos from taking the throne.

st: When a Man Loves a Woman
d: When Hercules proposes to Serena, he must deal with Iolaus' disapproval, Deianeira's hurt feelings and Ares' plot to destroy the relationship.
Waking from a nightmare, Hercules finds Serena dead and himself accused of murder.
Iolaus' search for his missing cousin Regina takes him to a commune where everyone has been brainwashed by a seemingly benevolent leader.
Mad King Augeas, thinking he is Zeus, becomes Hera's evil puppet.
The Chronos Stone takes Hercules five years into the past, where he meets Serena, the Golden Hind, once again.
Hercules and Iolaus rescue a kidnapped princess only to discover that her capture was part of a larger conspiracy to overthrow the rulers of two kingdoms.

st: A Rock and a Hard Place
d: A murder suspect escapes and flees into an old mine; Hercules is trapped in a cave-in.
Shipwrecked on Atlantis, Hercules offers to help a psychic convince her fellow citizens that the destruction of their island is imminent.
Hercules and Autolycus climb a beanstalk to rescue a captured lady.
When Iolaus accidentally lets a woman fall to her death, the goddess Fortune helps him by taking away his memory of everything he knows, including Hercules.
Hercules reminisces about the accidental death of a childhood bully, when Celesta arrives to take the brother of the deceased boy to the Elysian Fields.
Hercules must fight for his life when a demonic Serena look-a-like plots to capture his soul.
Hercules must reunite Aphrodite and Hephaestus to break a spell placed on the Amazons.
Hercules must help Oedipus and his daughter, Princess Antigone, battle the evil King Creon. With Kevin Sorbo, Mick Rose, Stelios Yiakmis, Paige Moss and Mark Clare.
Hercules and Iolaus are summoned by an old friend, Vlad, to fight vampires -- only to discover that they are to be his next victims.
